title: Heap Invariant Checker
prompt: Implement `bool heap_ok(const int *a, size_t n)` verifying the max-heap invariant: every node >= its children. NULL with n>0 violates; n<=1 is trivially ok.

tests.name: valid heap passes
tests.hint: Each parent (9,7,8) dominates its children — the lattice holds.

tests.name: broken heap caught
tests.hint: Child 10 exceeds parent 9: invariant violated at the first interior node.

tests.name: boundary cases
tests.hint: Empty and single-node heaps are trivially valid; NULL with n>0 is not a heap.
